The pair -- carries the sense in every case we have so far (a die <-> machine link is -- "this die runs on that machine"), so this defaults to a bare 'linked' -- rather than making every caller invent a verb. It is part of the UNIQUE -- key, so the same two records can be linked twice under different senses. relation TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'linked', -- Per-link facts that belong to the link and not to either record -- a -- cavity count, a setup note, a quantity. JSON so a new one does not need a -- migration; nothing reads it yet. metadata TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', created_at TEXT NOT NULL, created_by INTEGER, UNIQUE (left_type, left_id, right_type, right_id, relation), CHECK ( left_type < right_type OR (left_type = right_type AND left_id < right_id) ) )
